evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and refactors unit tests in src/test/script_tests.cpp and src/test/transaction_tests.cpp to eliminate shared mutable state across test cases.
rationale: Refactoring test cases to isolate state improves test suite cleanliness but does not fix test framework flakiness, expand high-risk coverage, or improve framework capabilities.
